title: 第八章 超凡的名堂第九章 船上诡闻
lines: 这显然不对劲。
李唯一想要停下，可是右足足心就像化为一座火山，不受控制的，喷涌出滚烫似岩浆般的气流。
与此同时，右足足心生长出一根银色痕脉，就像一颗种子发芽后长出的藤条，引导气流随它蔓延而上。
沿小腿，至大腿，穿过五脏六腑，过脖颈……
在李唯一睁开双目的瞬间，银色痕脉和气流汇聚于此，使瞳孔散发淡淡银光。
他的整个世界变得清晰起来，色彩更加丰富，细节也更加入微。
头顶上方，搭建医棚的铁皮上的锈迹和指痕印记清晰可辨，能由此推衍出搭建的先后顺序和过程。
空气中，一粒粒微不可查的灰尘，随他急促呼吸形成的气流而运动着。
棚门外的一缕缕幽雾，就像细密且拥有浅淡颜色的纱，不处不在，不孔不入，随风而动。
“这是……怎么了？”
李唯一惊疑不定，心跳如鼓，此刻看到的世界和以前完全不一样了！以前的双眼，仿佛是被一层模糊的镜片给盖住，以至浑浑噩噩活了十九年。
现在有一种跳出樊篱和泥沼的感觉。
瞳中银光散去。
但双目像是被重新塑造过，视力远胜从前。
看向旁边病床上的许教授，李唯一甚至能够从他脸上肌肉、皱纹、毛孔、汗毛的细微变化，感知到他内心的情绪。
花费好长时间，恢复平静后，他开始认真思考。
“这莫非就是师父说的，超凡的名堂？”
“师父说我肉身体魄早已接近临界点，是因为生不逢时，生错了时代，才无法更进一步。现在，坠落进微观世界，环境变了，所以瞬间就突破了临界点？”
李唯一脑海中生出多个猜测和念头，不过，觉得眼下体内发生的状况虽然未知，但绝不是什么坏事，于是开始主动摸索。
再次施展玉虚呼吸法。
随着右足足心那股滚烫气流涌出，他有意识的，引导这股气流，流向被类熊生物重创了的左臂。
第二条银色痕脉生长出来，引着滚烫气流，走另一条路线，延伸向他左臂，直至掌心。
滚烫气流流经伤口处时，那股原本火辣辣的疼痛，立时缓解了许多。继而，变得酸痒，像伤口愈合时长肉的感觉。
伤势在往好的方向发展。
“银色痕脉应该是先气流一步开辟出来的通道，细如发丝，路线曲折，接引气流至身体的一些部位。气流所过之处，就会滋润和改造血肉筋骨、五脏六腑……还有双目，全身都在脱变。”
“或许要不了多久，左臂的伤势，就能在这股滚烫气流的滋养下痊愈。而且，应该也会像双目一般，发生匪夷所思的超凡变化。”
李唯一就像打开了一扇可通天接地的神秘之门，欣喜若狂，随后完全沉浸在超凡领域的探索中。
“哈哈，唯一，唯一……”
赵勐快步疾行，兴高采烈冲进医棚，身上满是尘土和污垢。
忙完的他，刚得知李唯一苏醒的消息，立即就赶过来。
李唯一暂时停止探索超凡领域，将身体撑起来，背靠床架而坐，整个人全然不像先前那般虚弱无力，精气神饱满了许多。
赵勐翻来覆去看他半晌后，更加欣喜：“哈哈，奇了，真的是奇了，你这状态也太好了，脸色红润，眼睛有神，看来是一点问题都没有了！祁医生这医术，不佩服都不行。”
“祁医生医术固然了得，但蔡博士的鱼汤，药效却更胜一筹。”医棚最深处那张病床上，响起一个轻飘飘的声音。
是那个喜欢讲神话故事的矮个子，他脖子和右手臂上都绑着木板，眼神麻木，直盯棚顶。
他叫高欢，是许教授的学生之一。
不过他此刻既不高兴，也不欢乐。
蔡羽彤给李唯一喂食鱼汤，固然令人羡慕嫉妒。但先前他的两个同学来给许教授送鱼汤，却将他给遗忘，才是雪上加霜。
医棚外，响起大片急促的脚步声。
赵勐神色微变，连忙伏到李唯一耳边，低声道：“你昏迷后，发生了一些事，道祖太极鱼被我藏了起来，舍利子也在上面。但待会儿，他们若是问起，一定要装作什么都不知道。”
船长高鑫、杨主任、谢天殊、谢进……片刻间，十几人挤进医棚中，将李唯一的病床围得水泄不通。
“才刚醒，身体还很虚弱，得好好养伤。快躺下！”
content_en:
;;
Something is obviously wrong.
Li Weiwei wanted to stop, but the center of his right foot seemed to turn into a volcano, spewing out hot lava-like airflow uncontrollably.
At the same time, a silver vein grew from the center of the right foot, like a vine that grows after a seed germinates, guiding the airflow to spread upwards.
Along the calf, to the thigh, through the internal organs, and over the neck...
"Wow!"
The moment Li Weiwei opened his eyes, silver veins and airflow gathered here, causing his pupils to emit a faint silver light.
His entire world became clearer, with richer colors and subtler details.
Above the head, the rust and finger marks on the iron sheet used to build the medical shed are clearly visible, from which the sequence and process of construction can be deduced.
In the air, tiny specks of dust moved with the airflow caused by his rapid breathing.
The wisps of mist outside the shed door are like fine and light-colored gauze, everywhere, permeable, and move with the wind.
"What's...what's going on?"
Li Weiwei was shocked and confused, his heart beating like a drum. The world he saw now was completely different from before! In the past, my eyes seemed to be covered by a layer of blurry lenses, and I had lived in a state of confusion for nineteen years.
Now there is a feeling of jumping out of the barriers and quagmire.
The silver light in his pupils dispersed.
But his eyes seemed to have been reshaped, and his vision was far better than before.
Looking at Professor Xu on the bed next to him, Li Weiwei could even sense his inner emotions from the subtle changes in the muscles, wrinkles, pores, and hairs on his face.
After spending a long time to regain his composure, he began to think seriously.
"Is this the extraordinary fame that Master said?"
"Master said that my physical body has been close to the critical point for a long time. It was because I was born at the wrong time and in the wrong era that I couldn't go any further. Now, I fell into the microscopic world and the environment changed, so I broke through the critical point in an instant?"
Li Weiwei had many guesses and thoughts in his mind. However, he felt that although the situation happening in the body was unknown, it was by no means a bad thing, so he began to actively explore.
Use Yuxu Breathing Technique again.
As the hot air flowed out from the center of his right foot, he consciously guided this air flow to his left arm, which had been severely injured by the bear-like creature.
"Wow!"
A second silver vein grew out, leading the hot air to take another route, extending towards his left arm and into the palm of his hand.
When the hot air flowed through the wound, the burning pain immediately eased a lot. Then, it becomes sore and itchy, like the feeling of flesh growing when a wound is healing.
The injury is progressing in a good direction.
"The silver trace veins should be channels opened up first by the air flow. They are as thin as a hair, and the route is tortuous, guiding the air flow to some parts of the body. Wherever the air flow passes, it will nourish and transform the flesh, muscles, bones, internal organs... and the eyes. The whole body is undergoing transformation."
"Perhaps it won't be long before the injury to the left arm can be healed under the nourishment of this hot air. Moreover, like the eyes, it should also undergo incredible and extraordinary changes."
Li Weiyi was ecstatic as if he had opened a mysterious door that could connect the heavens and the earth, and then he was completely immersed in the exploration of the extraordinary realm.
…
"Haha, the only one, the only one..."
Zhao Meng walked quickly and rushed into the medical shed happily, his body covered with dust and dirt.
After finishing his work, he rushed over as soon as he learned the news that Li Weiwei had regained consciousness.
Li Weiwei temporarily stopped exploring the extraordinary realm, propped his body up, and sat with his back against the bed frame. He was no longer as weak as before, and he was much more energetic.
After Zhao Meng looked at him over and over for a while, he became even more delighted: "Haha, it's amazing, it's really amazing. You are in such good condition, with a rosy face and bright eyes. It seems that there is no problem at all! I can't help but admire Dr. Qi's medical skills."
"Doctor Qi's medical skills are certainly excellent, but Dr. Cai's fish soup is even more effective." A light voice sounded from the bed in the deepest part of the medical shed.
It was the short man who liked to tell fairy tales. He had boards tied around his neck and right arm, and his eyes were numb, staring straight at the ceiling.
His name is Gao Huan, and he is one of Professor Xu's students.
But he was neither happy nor happy at the moment.
Cai Yutong fed Li Weiwei fish soup, which is certainly enviable and jealous. But two of his classmates came to deliver fish soup to Professor Xu before, but forgot about him, which made matters worse.
Outside the medical shed, a large number of hurried footsteps could be heard.
Zhao Meng's expression changed slightly, and he quickly leaned into Li Weiwei's ear and whispered: "Something happened after you fell into coma. I hid the Taozu Tai Chi Fish and the relics were also on it. But if they ask about it later, they must pretend not to know anything."
Captain Gao Xin, Director Yang, Xie Tianshu, Xie Jin... In a moment, more than a dozen people crowded into the medical shed and surrounded Li Weiwei's hospital bed.
"I just woke up, and my body is still very weak. I need to take good care of myself. Lie down quickly!"
